reviews.text: I can’t recommend Dharma's Bed and Biscuit enough! The pricing is fantastic, the space is clean, and the staff is completely honest and reliable. It gives me total peace of mind knowing my pet is in great hands. This is my second time here and the peace and love for these dogs is definitely here. Looking forward to my next visit.
The only place I trust with grooming & boarding my fur babies! Charlie truly cares about animals. And has helped us so much with understanding our dogs needs.  Highly recommend. 🤌🐾 …

I cannot say enough good thing about Charlie and her team! My babies had such a wonderful experience staying with her through the weekend.

The facility itself is set up in her home, which is perfect for anxious babies, they felt right at home and were catered exactly to their level of energy. We received plenty of updates and photos throughout their stay, and our babies enjoyed plenty of human interaction and pet playtime as well. All of this with very affordable pricing! I can’t recommend enough!

Update: This week marks the one anniversary of my pet dying due to disease. For the past three months Dharma's Bed and Biscuit has been out on the streets of San Antonio to care for lady who is homeless and her pet also.
This business has gone out there twice and provided services for the homeless pet. The service is not simply grooming but most importantly a caring and compassionate heart to show the owner and her dog that they are loved and not abandoned.
I am so thankful that regardless that my dog is not alive to see and be treated with love and care by them. Had I not had the joy of meeting my dog and finding this wonderful services. I would not have been able to find someone who has taken their personal time to help the homeless brothers and sisters in Christ to care for their pets.

Previous:

Since 20 Apr 2022, I have been utilizing the services there. Previously I had gone to different grooming and care services for my dog. I continue to attend Dharma's Bed and Biscuit because the service is unique. How so you may wonder. Anytime schedule an appointment the service show up at my home on time. Also they are typically ahead of schedule and they will come to your home or business with their mobile unit with your permission early. That alone helps me continue get to my other daily routines. This summer 2024 the owner's main A/C unit went out of service. The owner improvised and moved all of her fur guest into an A/C garage with all their food, water, beds, cages, and other supplies. Any pets owner is aware of the unfortunate risks incurred by leaving them with just anyone while on a vacation that the pets can not travel to. The care and gentleness given by Dharma's Bed and Biscuit is rare. I highly recommend this mom and pop store.

Here’s a polished, long-form review you can copy and paste anywhere (Google, Rover, Yelp, etc.). I kept your voice but made it flow smoothly and sound professional and heartfelt:

⸻

We cannot say enough great things about Charlie and the care she provided for our dogs during the Christmas holiday season. From the very beginning, she went above and beyond to make us feel comfortable and confident leaving our dogs with her. She was incredibly flexible and even offered a free consultation visit so our dogs could see the space and make sure they felt comfortable before their stay. That alone meant so much to us.

Her home is immaculate. Extremely tidy, clean, and honestly impressive, especially considering she watches over more than 10 dogs at a time. The house smelled fresh and clean, which immediately reassured us. Charlie has an abundance of resources for the dogs, including beds & kennels from large to small. And they all looked practically brand new. She also had plenty of soft, cozy blankets available, which made the space feel warm and welcoming.

The yard is absolutely amazing!! Very spacious and perfect for both small and large dogs to safely play and explore. We have two large dogs and one small dog, and all three of them had an incredible time. Our small dog is a Chihuahua who struggles with anxiety, and we were amazed at how quickly she came out of her shell while staying with Charlie. That alone speaks volumes about the level of care, patience, and attention she provides.

Throughout the stay, Charlie sent us multiple pictures every single day along with detailed updates. She does an excellent job keeping pet parents informed and clearly gives the dogs a lot of individual attention and love. We never once felt out of the loop or worried about how our dogs were doing.

On top of all that, her pricing is very affordable, especially for the level of care she provides. She was also unbelievably flexible with our scheduling. We had several last-minute changes (extending our stay, shortening it, and adjusting dates due to unexpected circumstances) and Charlie handled everything with patience, kindness, and understanding.

If you’re looking for someone trustworthy, caring, organized, and genuinely passionate about dogs, Charlie and Dharma’s Bed & Biscuit are truly exceptional. We would absolutely use her services again and highly recommend her to anyone looking for top-tier care for their pets.

Had a meet and greet with them and my family and I feel super comfortable leaving our pets in their hands while we are away on vacation! Looking forward to working with Charlie and the gang next week while away! Update to come!

You will not find anyone better to love your fur babies as much as you do. She is not only EXCELLENT with our pups, but also extremely knowledgeable about them as well. WE LOVE HER! She also has the best helpers in the business.😊
Took  great care of my dog for the day—reliable, kind, and highly recommended!

If I could give more than 5 stars I would!
Charlie and her crew are the absolute best!
I trust my 2 fur kids with her completely!
Not only does she come to take care of our guys while we’re gone, she also comes weekly to take care of their special medical needs. Can’t even express how grateful we are to know our kitties are being taken care of so well!

Absolutely incredible. My dogs, as well as us humans, feel safe, secure and at peace knowing they are getting the care they so deserve. I love that it is a little oasis away from home where they can run, play and relax in the comfortable environment that is Dharma’s Bed and Breakfast. I can’t say enough positive about it! Charlie is the dog whisperer, she has an energy that is so uplifting and the animals feel it as soon as they get on the property! The grooming services are fantastic as well. They can literally do it all!!

Dharma's has become like a second home to our dog, and he always greets Charlie with happy tail wags and lots of kisses! He loves and trusts her, even though he's only been with her every few weeks for either grooming or boarding over the past 3 years. Charlie combines knowledge and experience with tons of love for the dogs she has in her home, and we know that it's been a happy, safe place for our dog. We highly recommend Dharma's Bed and Biscuit for your canine companions too! 😊 ❤️ 🐕

House full of Love, attentive care, and fun - thats what my dogs and I say about Dharma’s!
Best care in the San Antonio area! I tell all my friends and clients about Charlie! She is amazing!
